title: Syntara Plugin Build Settings
description: Non-secret, plugin-root build and release settings for the Syntara plugin authoring CLI.

apiVersion.description: The versioned Syntara settings API implemented by this document.

kind.description: Identifies this YAML document as plugin build and release settings.

manifest.description: Path to the plugin.yaml bundle inventory. Relative paths are resolved from this settings file.

output.description: Optional JSON-output defaults for every command that supports JSON, plus verbose-output defaults for commands that support verbose progress.

verbose.description: Default verbose output. An explicit --verbose command-line option takes precedence.

json.description: Default machine-readable JSON output. An explicit --json command-line option takes precedence.

registry.description: Shared non-secret OCI registry coordinates for the plugin release.

origin.description: Registry origin, including scheme and optional port, such as https://registry.example.test.

artifactRepository.description: Repository that stores the published plugin metadata OCI artifact.

workloadRepository.description: Repository that stores the custom-workload container image, when the plugin declares one.

catalogRepository.description: Repository that stores the catalog-index OCI artifact used for plugin discovery.

username.description: Registry username. Supply its password only through the command's standard-input option.

authFile.description: Path to a local Docker- or Podman-compatible auth.json file with an inline Basic credential. Relative paths are resolved from this settings file; the file itself is never bundled into an artifact.

allowInsecureLoopbackHttp.description: Permits HTTP only for localhost or 127.0.0.1 development registries; all other registries require TLS.

build.description: Settings for deterministic metadata-artifact assembly and an optional custom-workload image build.

artifactOutput.description: Output path for the generated plugin metadata OCI archive (.oci.tar). Relative paths are resolved from this settings file.

imageBindings.description: Existing immutable custom-workload image references indexed by logical image ID.

additionalProperties.description: An immutable OCI image reference in repository@sha256:digest form.

workload.description: One author-owned custom-workload image build target. It is used only with the explicit --with-workload command option.

engine.description: Container engine used to build and push the custom-workload image. Podman is the currently supported engine.

context.description: Container build context directory. Relative paths are resolved from this settings file.

containerfile.description: Path to the Containerfile within the selected build context. Relative paths are resolved from this settings file.

tag.description: Mutable build-and-push tag used only to obtain the registry's resulting immutable image digest.

platform.description: Target operating system and architecture, such as linux/arm64.

imageId.description: Logical custom-workload image identifier declared by plugin.yaml and bound to the pushed digest.

publish.description: Destination defaults for publishing the prebuilt plugin metadata artifact.

artifact.description: Optional path to an existing plugin metadata OCI archive to publish or use for a catalog update.

channel.description: OCI tag channel for the published plugin metadata artifact.

catalog.description: Defaults for explicitly creating or extending the shared plugin catalog index.

sourceId.description: Stable catalog-source identity that the Syntara control plane is configured to reconcile.

channel.description: OCI tag channel for the catalog-index artifact, commonly stable.

expiresInHours.description: Validity period, in positive hours, assigned to a newly published catalog index.
